name: Usage limit approaching
description: Warns that an account is close to a plan limit, showing how much is used, what happens at the ceiling, and the two ways out.

origin.note: Design: gauge — the percentage as the headline figure, a usage bar, and two unequal remedies.

subject: You've used {{ used_percent }} of your {{ limit_name }}
preheader: At the limit, {{ at_limit_behaviour }}. Two ways to avoid it.

limit_name.description: What is running out, in the customer's language.

used_percent.description: How much is used, as a percentage string. Shown at display size.

used_label.description: The same fact in absolute numbers, which is what people actually act on.

resets_at.description: When the allowance resets, if it does. Often the cheapest answer is simply waiting.

at_limit_behaviour.description: What happens at the ceiling. Say it exactly: throttled, queued, blocked or charged.
at_limit_behaviour.default: further sends are queued until the allowance resets

usage_url.description: Where the detailed usage breakdown lives, for people who want to reduce instead of upgrade.
